items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Bobby -- Bobby Johnson, Tenor saxophone player, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, and I went in there and I played first trumpet for him, because -- I'm trying to think, who was his first trumpet? Who left? When I came in. Well, on some of the recording dates I played, it was that way, I played first because I was a soloist, and sang a couple of things with them, and played -- you know.
Anybody that you remember particularly from the band? From the Claude Hopkins Band?

Claude Hopkins group? Yeah. Howard Johnson on the -- tenor piano, then, he was playing. Let's see, the banjo player, guitar player, who he had had -- been with him for years, hm, hm, hm, well let me move on. What the heck,
